# THE HALF-RADIUS BLOCKS. `Frame 720` runs at itemSpacing ZERO and its two
# children carry half a radius each: `Frame 271` r12/12/0/0 on #122524 over
# `Frame 606` r0/0/12/12 on #052D2D. The tab `section` is built the same way,
# `Frame 27` r12/12/0/0 over `Frame 267` r0/0/16/16, flush. Both were shipped as
# separate r16 cards, which drew a seam the artwork does not have and painted
# the meta half in the card colour instead of the one fill on this page that is
# neither the card colour nor the ground. The #052D2D is not a single reading:
# THE TOKEN ROW'S COLUMNS. Separate commit, 81f31cd47. The row was
# `justify-between` over three children with a hugging leading cell, so the free
# space split into two equal gaps and the market-cap column started wherever the
# token name ended - a different x on every row of the same table. The frame's
# row is SPACE_BETWEEN over FOUR children and the fourth is the sparkline:
# `social_tokens` holds one current market cap with no history table behind it,
# so the sparkline has no series and is not drawn; three children under the same
# rule cannot reproduce a slack share that exists only because a fourth child is
# there. The columns are anchored from the right instead, which reproduces the
# two positions that ARE reproducible exactly - the kebab's 20 of clear at
# 283/640/693, and the figure block's right edge at 664, where 4966:148961's
# 248-wide heading group ends.
# NOTHING HERE IS PROMOTED. Both families keep `partial`, and the reason is the
# same one on every row: the shell draws a red Block button that has no
# `user_blocks` table and no block or mute RPC behind it, and the Tokens table
# draws a sparkline and a change line that have no series. Neither is geometry
# and neither can be closed from this directory. The shell carries a second
# reason that is worth reading on its own - see the rows.
# THE DESKTOP RUNGS, AND WHAT THEY DO NOT COVER. Commit 20cc5a6cb. The stat
# tile's box is flat at all three boards - radius 8, padding 10, gap 4 on
# #001615 - and only the type inside it moves: label 12/14, 12/14, 12/16 and
# Mulish Regular at -4pct. The shell shipped both at the phone rung. The
# identity block rounds to 24 at 1440 (9653:214900 r24/24/0/0 over 9653:214924
# r0/0/24/24, padding 24/16/32/16, itemSpacing 24) and the tab strip's top
# corners take 16 (4997:155270) while the body keeps its 16 (4997:155280).
# Those are VALUES, not the desktop LAYOUT. At 1440 `Frame 715` turns
# HORIZONTAL and splits into a 761 column and a 367 rail, and `Frame 775` moves
# out of the stack into that rail; the shell is still one column. That split is
# a page composition and it belongs to whatever mounts this component, which is
# the same thing the rows say nothing mounts yet.
# 225 checks pass across src/components/social/profile/__tests__ (13 files),
# counted off the run rather than estimated. Fourteen of them are new this pass

Every one of those was shipped wrong in the same direction - two r16 bg-card cards with an 8px seam between them, a 22 where the frame spends 24, a 10 where it spends 16 - and all of them now resolve here and step at md. And the component is NOT MOUNTED - /:username renders src/pages/account/UserProfile.tsx, another lane's file, so this frame's parity is currently a property of a component no user reaches. A done row here would claim a screen that nothing renders. The desktop rungs landed with them in 20cc5a6cb - the stat tile's figure ramp 14/16 to 16/20 to 22/26, the identity block's r24 halves and the strip's r16 top - but the desktop LAYOUT did not: at 1440 Frame 715 turns horizontal and pulls Frame 775 out into a 367 rail, and this component is still one column.
